flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code to add a notice to a court application batch or send the batch. Only related: ocmsadminapi workflows/furnish/stafffurnish/services/StaffFurnishService.staffUpdateOffenderAndAddress (address update, stage unchanged) and OcmsOffenceNoticeDetail (batch_no commented out).
note: URA status: Demo paid (50% of 75%), demo_remark: Vault Code Split (Vault permission for the api App Service server; cannot verify from repo). The story asks that a notice whose address was amended and confirmed is included in the batch with the other notices whose addresses were updated, so the batch can be sent for court application. There is no batch number and no process grouping notices into a court batch: batch_no in OcmsOffenceNoticeDetail is commented out as 'NOT USED NOW' in both APIs, and the staff address update changes neither the stage nor a batch. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Not supported by repo code. Do not claim as done; ask URA/team in which repo grouping notices into a court application batch is built, or mark it as a gap

steps.step: A notice whose address was amended and confirmed by the OIC is marked ready for the batch
steps.detail: staffUpdateOffenderAndAddress only saves the address and returns the old stage ('Keep existing stage', StaffFurnishService.java:606-611); there is no flag or 'address confirmed' status for a court batch.

steps.step: OCMS includes the notice in the batch together with the other notices that have their addresses updated
steps.detail: batch_no is commented out as 'NOT USED NOW' (OcmsOffenceNoticeDetail.java:66-68 in ocmsadminprivateapi, :60-62 in ocmsadminapi). No code writes or reads a court batch. grep with no result in the six repos for court_app / courtapp / court application / shortlist / court_batch / csd_batch / ocms_work_item (other than DataHive placeholder comments and UI labels).

steps.step: OCMS sends the batch of notices for court application
steps.detail: There is no court application batch submission. Only a report menu 'Court Application Submit Reports' with an empty path exists (Report/index.tsx:65-68) and a commented-out courtcasesummary resource (ActionReport.tsx:43-48); there is no controller or cron submitting to State Courts in the six repos.
